en.headline: Customs bust etomidate lab in Kam Tin, seize HK$42 million haul
en.dek: A 61-year-old man was arrested after officers found a semi-automated production line and materials capable of making more than 160,000 capsules at a village house.
body: Hong Kong Customs said on Wednesday that officers had dismantled a suspected etomidate manufacturing centre in a village house in Kam Tin, Yuen Long, and arrested a 61-year-old local man.

Senior investigator Chan Kit-lun of the Drug Investigation Bureau said the operation on Tuesday yielded more than 3,000 suspected etomidate capsules, about 13.4 kilograms of liquid etomidate, roughly 3 kilograms of powder, and packaging and manufacturing equipment. The haul has an estimated market value of about HK$42 million.

Chan said this was the first time Customs had found a drug trafficking syndicate using a high-precision liquid-filling machine to set up a semi-automated production line capable of mass-producing capsules of precise capacity. Combined with the raw materials seized, the line could have produced more than 160,000 capsules in a short time.

The man was charged with one count of manufacturing a dangerous drug and one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug. He is due to appear at Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, each offence carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關錦田村屋搗依托咪酯工場 檢市值約4200萬元拘一男
zh.dek: 61歲男子被控製造及販運危險藥物，單位內設半自動化生產線，原材料可短時間製逾16萬粒煙彈。
body: 香港海關周三表示，人員在元朗錦田一間村屋搗破懷疑依托咪酯製毒工場，拘捕一名61歲本地男子。
毒品調查科高級調查主任陳杰論表示，行動於周二進行，檢獲超過3000粒懷疑依托咪酯煙彈、約13.4公斤液態依托咪酯、約3公斤粉末，以及一批製毒及包裝工具，估計市值約4200萬元。
陳杰論指，海關首次發現販毒集團利用高精密度液態填充機設立半自動化生產線，務求大量生產容量精準的煙彈。若原材料配合生產線，可於短時間內生產逾16萬粒煙彈。
該名男子被控一項製造危險藥物罪及一項販運危險藥物罪，周四在屯門裁判法院提堂。根據《危險藥物條例》，每項罪行最高可判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
